### LB-proved

Added 2026-11-20 (not preregistered). LB with the `m >= 3` degree floor replaced by the carry bound `m min(k, m-1) + 1` (written proof, under review); `m = 2` keeps its proved per-failed-attempt floor. Floor `C(mk, min(D, floor(mk/2)))` (equal to `C(mk, D)` wherever `D <= mk/2`; the convention of LB+onset). For `k <= m-1` successes are charged 1 (the grid condition is proved on unit ideals).
